questions.text:
Question 1 is based on the following Figure 1.

Inventor 'Y' was France's most celebrated mathematician and physicist. In 1642, inventor 'Y' invented and built the first working calculating machine as a means of helping his father to perform tedious tax accounting.

assets.label: Figure 1
assets.caption: Figure 1: Inventor 'Y' and his calculating machine.

subparts.label: a
subparts.text: Who is inventor 'Y'?

subparts.label: b
subparts.text: Name another calculating machine that was invented in the same generation as inventor Y's calculating machine.

subparts.label: c
subparts.text: Which programming language is named after inventor 'Y'?

subparts.label: d
subparts.text: State TWO (2) mathematical operations that can be performed by inventor Y's calculating machine.

questions.text:

The development of component X led to a drastic increase in speed and efficiency of computers. Component X is a single, complete electronic semiconductor circuit contained on pieces of silicon, and sometimes called as chips.

subparts.label: a
subparts.text: What is the name of component X?

subparts.label: b
subparts.text: In which computer generation was component X introduced?

subparts.label: c
subparts.text: Who is the inventor of component X?

subparts.label: d
subparts.text: State ONE (1) input device and ONE (1) output device that was introduced in the same generation as component X.

subparts.label: b
subparts.text: Determine the size of the register and provide relevant justification.

subparts.text: Discuss what will happen if system interconnection is blocked from the perspective of the machine cycle.

subparts.label: d
